ESCHER SPIRAL OF A FEEDBACK TUNNEL	A shader bends the monitor-in-monitor picture round its centre,	so the nested screens join into one spiral. It zooms in a level every 4 bars.
ONE-BIT FEEDBACK, NEGATIVE AT EVERY LEVEL	The screen shows this camera's previous frame as a negative,	so each copy inverts the one outside it. Every kick drum swaps black and white.
